name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
value: US, Mexico, Bolivia lose elimination (17 Nov)
summary: PAHO confirmed on 17 Nov that the US, Mexico and Bolivia lost measles elimination; US cases highest since 1991
state: PAHO announced on 17 Nov that its commission, meeting 10–13 Nov, concluded that the United States, Mexico and Bolivia have lost measles elimination status after 12 months or more of continuous transmission; Canada lost it in 2025 (Health Policy Watch). The US has over 5,400 confirmed cases in 2026, the most since 1991, and 10 measles-associated deaths (ITV, citing AP). Mexico confirmed 13,800 cases to October. Loss of elimination status meets Watch; the Alert line on a multi-country surge with rising deaths is not clearly crossed.
for_you: Two doses of MMR vaccine give strong protection. UKHSA and the NHS advise checking vaccination records before travel, including to North America; FCDO travel advice lists country health risks.
rubric_hit: Watch: loss of elimination status (US, Mexico, Bolivia, PAHO 17 Nov); rising-deaths Alert line not clearly crossed

sources.title: Health Policy Watch — Three countries in the Americas lose measles-free status
ITV News (AP) — Measles is no longer considered eliminated in the US and Mexico

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
